lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a regular grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with columns of spots, creating a lattice structure where high-luminance blobs serve as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light pixels on the superior edge and shadow pixels on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin, presenting as deep, irregular serrated notches or amputations.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible, with at least two attached to the ventral and posterior margins of the left pectoral fin.
